advisories.affected_preconditions: QUIC certificate verification with wolfSSL and a bad cipher/curve.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: No wolfSSL backend and no HTTP/3 support in either installed library; upstream also limits the affected release to 8.6.0.
advisories.title: QUIC certificate check bypass with wolfSSL

advisories.affected_preconditions: Automatic gzip decompression with zlib 1.2.0.3 or older.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: Both installed libraries report zlib 1.2.13, outside the advisory prerequisite.
advisories.title: gzip integer overflow

advisories.affected_preconditions: SFTP transfers using the wolfSSH backend.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: Both installed libraries report libssh2/1.10.0, not wolfSSH.
advisories.title: missing SFTP host verification with wolfSSH

advisories.affected_preconditions: Concurrent LDAPS transfers changing TLS verification options.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: LDAP/LDAPS are compiled in; concurrent consumer behavior was not established.
advisories.title: broken TLS options for threaded LDAPS

advisories.affected_preconditions: SCP/SFTP known_hosts checks using libssh global known_hosts.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: Upstream explicitly excludes libssh2; both installed libraries use libssh2/1.10.0.
advisories.title: libssh global known_hosts override

advisories.affected_preconditions: SCP/SFTP public-key authentication unintentionally using an SSH agent with libssh.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: Upstream explicitly excludes libssh2; both installed libraries use libssh2/1.10.0.
advisories.title: libssh key passphrase bypass without agent set

advisories.affected_preconditions: HTTP/2 stream-dependency options followed by easy reset and cleanup.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: HTTP/2 is enabled; API sequence applicability is unresolved.

bookworm_status.nodsa: Minor issue; needs rare CURLOPT_STREAM_DEPENDS + reset/cleanup

advisories.title: HTTP/2 stream-dependency tree UAF

advisories.affected_preconditions: Digest-authenticated transfer followed by another origin on the same easy handle.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: HTTP authentication and handle reuse remain supported; consumer sequence is unresolved.

bookworm_status.nodsa: Minor issue; needs Digest auth + libcurl handle reuse across origins

advisories.title: cross-origin Digest auth state leak

advisories.affected_preconditions: curl CLI schemeless URL plus --proto-default sftp/scp skips tool-layer SSH initialization.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: Upstream labels this tool-only. The curl package owns /usr/bin/curl; neither library package does. CLI behavior remains open.

bookworm_status.nodsa: Minor issue; needs schemeless URL with --proto-default sftp/scp

advisories.title: proto-default skips SSH verification

advisories.affected_preconditions: LDAP SASL negotiation with a premature MITM handshake response.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: LDAP and authentication support are present; runtime exposure is unresolved.
advisories.title: OpenLDAP SASL authentication bypass

advisories.affected_preconditions: HTTP/2 server push with shared connections during cleanup.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: HTTP/2 is enabled; server-push/connection-sharing use is unresolved.
advisories.title: HTTP/2 server push UAF

advisories.affected_preconditions: Negotiate connection reuse across different users on the same HTTP origin.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: Negotiate/GSSAPI support is present; credential-reuse behavior is unresolved.
advisories.title: bad reuse of HTTP Negotiate connection

advisories.affected_preconditions: Negotiate-authenticated pooled connection reused after initial empty credentials.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: Negotiate/GSSAPI support is present; ambient identity/reuse behavior is unresolved.
advisories.title: Negotiate ambient user conn reuse

advisories.affected_preconditions: Clear-text IMAP/SMTP/POP3 connection reused by a TLS-required transfer.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: These protocols are enabled; connection-pool sequence is unresolved.
advisories.title: connection reuse ignores TLS requirement

advisories.affected_preconditions: Negotiate followed by another authentication method/user on the same origin.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: Negotiate/GSSAPI support is present; mixed-credential reuse is unresolved.
advisories.title: wrong reuse of HTTP Negotiate connection

advisories.affected_preconditions: Different scheme-specific proxies, first with credentials, second without, and a cross-scheme redirect.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: Proxy and redirect support remain available; operator configuration is unresolved.
advisories.title: proxy credentials leak over redirect-to proxy

advisories.affected_preconditions: Custom Host header cleared on the same easy handle leaves stale cookie origin.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: Cookie and header handling remain supported; consumer sequence is unresolved.
advisories.title: stale custom cookie host causes cookie leak

advisories.affected_preconditions: netrc credentials and followed HTTP redirects under connection reuse conditions.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: netrc and redirect support remain available; operator configuration is unresolved.
advisories.title: netrc credential leak with reused proxy connection

advisories.affected_preconditions: OpenSSL public-key pinning with peer and hostname verification disabled and no server certificate.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: Upstream explicitly restricts affected TLS backends to OpenSSL. The GnuTLS library is excluded; OpenSSL CLI/library applicability remains unresolved.
advisories.title: OpenSSL pinning bypass

advisories.affected_preconditions: PSL-enabled cookies with an explicit Domain matching an origin that is itself a public suffix.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: PSL is enabled in both libraries; this prerequisite is present, not a mitigation.
advisories.title: domain-scoped PSL domain cookie

advisories.affected_preconditions: STARTTLS transfer reuses a live connection with incompatible TLS configuration.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: STARTTLS-capable protocols are present; connection configuration reuse is unresolved.

bookworm_status.nodsa: Minor issue; STARTTLS connection reuse config mismatch

advisories.title: wrong STARTTLS connection reuse

advisories.affected_preconditions: Negotiate connection reuse across different service names.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: Negotiate/GSSAPI support is present; service-name reuse behavior is unresolved.

bookworm_status.nodsa: Minor issue; needs HTTP Negotiate auth with differing service names

advisories.title: wrong reuse for different services

advisories.affected_preconditions: Trailing-dot cookie domain bypass permits super cookies.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: Debian describes PSL as mitigating, not resolving, this issue; upstream still reports a cookie boundary flaw. Keep open.

bookworm_status.nodsa: Minor issue; trailing-dot super cookie; PSL-enabled build mitigates

advisories.title: trailing dot domain super cookie

advisories.affected_preconditions: One handle uses different environment-configured proxies after Digest proxy authentication.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: Proxy authentication and handle reuse remain supported; operator sequence is unresolved.

bookworm_status.nodsa: Minor issue; libcurl env-proxy Digest auth handle reuse

advisories.title: env-set cross-proxy Digest auth state leak

advisories.affected_preconditions: Pooled TLS connections reused after client-certificate/private-key options change.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: mTLS and connection reuse remain supported; consumer configuration is unresolved.

bookworm_status.nodsa: Minor issue; libcurl mTLS handle-reuse config mismatch

advisories.title: incomplete mTLS config matching in conn reuse

advisories.affected_preconditions: SCP/SFTP SSH_KEYFUNCTION callback with a host-key type mismatch in known_hosts.
advisories.artifact_bound_reasoning: libssh2 and SCP/SFTP are present; callback use and key mismatch behavior are unresolved.
advisories.title: SSH improper host validation

method: One observation per raw scanner finding; source_index is zero-based within the named result array. Groups merge only the same component type/name/version and an exact advisory ID or one explicit, unambiguous CVE alias. Different package identities and unmatched aliases stay separate; groups are not risk dispositions.
scope_note: Only the installed Debian curl source family. All original scanner observations remain; these researched dispositions are not suppressions, risk acceptance, remediation, or M2 clearance.
